name: Fool-Moon Love
source:
You play as Orion 'Chekhov' Carver, a socially awkward college student in the north of England looking to date Amaryllis Wyrmwood, his headstrong classmate. There's only a few days left until the Full Moon Festival in your town and things seem to be getting sinister... with both the world around you and Orion himself. 

Will you win Amaryllis' heart, or be consumed by the dark?

[From [url=https://rainbowteef.itch.io/fool-moon-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演猎户座“契诃夫”卡弗，一位生活在英格兰北部、不善社交的大学生，想要和他固执的同学阿玛丽利斯·沃姆伍德约会。距离你所在城镇的满月节只剩几天了，事情似乎变得越来越险恶……无论是你周围的世界还是猎户座本人。

你会赢得阿玛丽利斯的心，还是被黑暗吞噬？

[来自[url=https://rainbowteef.itch.io/fool-moon-love]Itch.io[/url]]
